descriptionChirho: A physical doorway or entrance to a building, room, or enclosed space; also used metaphorically for access or opportunity (e.g., 'I am the door', 'a door was opened'). All three clusters are purely number and case variants of the same noun: singular forms across various cases (S69319), dative/genitive plural (S69320), and accusative/nominative plural (S69321). Translations are completely consistent: 'door(s)' (eng), 'puerta(s)' (spa), 'mlango/milango' (swa: door/doors), 'dwaar/darwaazon' (hin: door/doors), 'baab/abwaab' (arb: door/doors), 'mun/mundeul' (kor: door/doors). No semantic distinction between singular and plural warrants separate senses.
